question: From the circumcentre L of ΔXYZ, perpendicular LM is drawn on side YZ. If ∠YXZ = 60°, then the measure of ∠YLM is :
solution:
**Given:**

∠YXZ = 60°

**Calculation:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f91c81a29d7b948e708d29b4d0ac79d97a01d08be6f2cc20cc6fd5db06326575.png] 

As L is the circumcentre so, ∠YLZ = 2∠YXZ

So, ∠YLZ = 120°

Now,

YL = LZ = radius of the circumcircle

So,

∠LYZ = ∠LZY = 30°

∠YLM = 180° - 90° - 30°

⇒ 60°

**∴ The measure of ∠YLM is 60°.**
